scripts.postinstall: for d in plugins/*/; do if [ -f "$d/bun.lock" ]; then (cd "$d" && bun install --frozen-lockfile) || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . && for d in plugins/*/; do if [ -f "$d.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ]; then claude plugin validate "$d" || exit 1; fi; done && bun scripts/check-opencode.mjs
